objective: Add a boundary layer coverage gate to every credential that grades on drag alone
rationale: Measured on the NACA 4412 wing: across a 17.7 fold change in boundary layer coverage from 4.36 to 77.0 percent at fixed refinement, drag moved 0.037 percent while lift moved 9.41 percent. Drag agreement is therefore not evidence of a resolved boundary layer on a low aspect ratio wing, because induced drag is roughly half the total and is set by lift distribution rather than near wall resolution. A drag only credential can read as converged over a badly under resolved boundary layer
cost_basis: estimate, a check added to existing grading code plus a re-grade of current wall credentials
expected_knowledge_gain: Removal of a silent failure mode from the credentials wall, and a stated coverage figure on every drag credential
